title: Officer justified in shooting Grassy Narrows shooting: SIU
article: A provincial police officer was justified in the fatal shooting of a Grassy Narrows youth, the Special Investigations Unit says.
Geronimo Fobister, 17, was shot during a standoff with OPP officers on Aug. 27. He was taken to hospital, where he was pronounced dead.

John Sutherland, director of the civilian-run agency that investigates all incidents of injury or death involving police, said in a release that the conclusion was based on evidence gathered during an eight-week investigation.
In the early-morning hours of Aug. 27, Fobister and John Hyacinthe, 20, confronted a resident of the community. Police reported shots were fired and the two men fled.
Police arrested Hyacinthe and searched for Fobister, who was found lying on his back on a trail in a heavily wooded area near his home with a shotgun across his chest.
Fobister said the shotgun was loaded and he threatened to shoot if the officers moved toward him.
